general_changes:
Significant Action Speed increases to nearly all Skills, allowing more opportunistic use/mixups and further differentiating them from charged attacks. Skill strength generally increased but costs more FP (deters spamming, complemented by ERR's FP recovery changes). Most Ashes of War now base their effect damage on their own scaling, overriding the weapon's. Bows of all types can equip Ashes valid for 'All Armaments'. Weapon catalysts can equip Ashes valid for their moveset/original armament class. New affinities mean some skills changed default affinity (e.g. gravity-based AoW now default to the new Gravitational affinity). Certain weapons gained default skills not normally available to that class. Catalysts, weapon catalysts, shields, and all ranged weapon types have expanded AoW options.

Ash of War Enkindling replaces AoW duplication at Smithing Master Hewg, using Lost Ashes; Legendary-grade Enkindled AoW can be applied to Somber armaments.

Mystic Ashes are a variant of AoW allowing spells with 0 or 1 Memory Slot cost to be applied as a catalyst's skill. Most catalysts already have a Mystic Ash as their default skill. Requires the Spellsmith's Etching Tool (purchased from Smithing Master Iji, Liurnia) before Mystic Ash customization unlocks at Smithing Master Hewg; the corresponding spell must be owned first.

skills.effect: This skill originates from the lifeforms of the Crucible. Grow a golden pair of wings and take to the air before diving down at the foe, weapon first. A spinning attack is performed when wielding a twinblade.
skills.name: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings

skills.effect: Skill that masks the user's presence at the cost of a self-inflicted wound. Grants near-invisibility to and reduces sounds produced by the user. Critical attacks are also enhanced while this skill is active.
skills.name: Assassin's Gambit

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments - No Daggers, Thrusting Swords, Whips
skills.effect: Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
skills.name: Barbaric Roar
skills.scaling_note: Roar damage scales with Strength.

skills.effect: Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.
skills.name: Barrage

skills.effect: Skill made famous by Sir Neidhardt. Enter a stance briefly capable of deflecting enemy attacks.
skills.name: Barricade

skills.effect: Unleash a beastly roar, rending the air as a forward-travelling projectile.
skills.name: Beast's Roar
skills.scaling_note: Roar damage scales with Strength and Dexterity. Target priority increased during animation.

skills.effect: Spin armament overhead and then plunge it into the ground to summon a raging vortex of black flames. Hold to create an initial flame tornado while spinning the armament.
skills.name: Black Flame Tornado
skills.scaling_note: Fire damage scales with Faith.

skills.effect: Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.
skills.name: Blind Spot

skills.effect: Skill used by the golden knights who served Godwyn. From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed.
skills.name: Blinkbolt
skills.scaling_note: Lightning damage scales with Faith.

skills.effect: Wound self to coat the armament with blood, then unleash an airborne blood blade that causes hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession.
skills.name: Blood Blade
skills.scaling_note: Blood slash damage scales with Arcane. Also inflicts Blood Loss buildup on self.

skills.effect: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts that rob the target of both their blood and their HP.
skills.name: Blood Tax

skills.effect: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. From a low stance, coat the blade in your own blood to unleash a rending blood slash in a wide arc.
skills.name: Bloody Slash
skills.scaling_note: Blood slash damage scales with Arcane. Also inflicts Blood Loss buildup on self.

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments, Catalysts - No Daggers, Thrusting Swords, Whips
skills.effect: Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.
skills.name: Braggart's Roar
skills.scaling_note: Roar damage scales with Strength. Target priority increased during animation.

skills.acquisition: Found in Caria Manor, replacing Carian Grandeur.
skills.effect: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power.
skills.name: Carian Greatsword
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Intelligence.

skills.effect: Swing the shield to dispel incoming sorceries and incantations, transforming the magic into retaliatory glintblades. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry.
skills.name: Carian Retaliation
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Intelligence. Costs FP even when not reflecting a spell. Has 5 active parry frames.

skills.effect: Skill passed down the Carian royal family. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and bring it down. Additional input follows up with a horizontal sweep. Charge either attack to enhance potency.
skills.name: Carian Sovereignty
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Intelligence.

skills.effect: Quickly charge forward with the armament at the hip, carrying the momentum into a thrust. Hold to cover a greater distance.
skills.name: Charge Forth
skills.scaling_note: Benefits from bonuses to running attacks.

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments - No Whips, Fists, Claws
skills.effect: Coat armament in frost, and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards. The armament retains its frost for a while.
skills.name: Chilling Mist
skills.scaling_note: Mist damage scales with Dexterity and Intelligence.

skills.effect: Skill that manipulates gravity. Bury the armament in the ground, pulling rocks from the earth to reinforce it. Increases attack power and makes it easier to break enemy stance.
skills.name: Cragblade

skills.effect: A knightly skill. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, powering up your next attack.
skills.name: Determination

skills.effect: A skill which imitates the wrath of the divine beast's dance. Lift a leg up high and stamp it down with great force, sending a powerful wave of frost straight out along the ground. Can be charged to increase power and range.
skills.name: Divine Beast Frost Stomp
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Dexterity and Intelligence.

skills.effect: Skill of superior swordsmen. Perform a crossing slash attack from a low stance. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
skills.name: Double Slash

skills.effect: This skill represents the pinnacle of Dane's footwork-based martial artistry. Rise into the air with a series of spinning kicks before crashing down with one final strike. Imbues kicking attacks with energy, increasing their range.
skills.name: Dryleaf Whirlwind
skills.scaling_note: Damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.armaments: Greataxes, Great Hammers, Great Spears, Colossal Weapons
skills.effect: Thrust the armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash an earth-shaking shockwave. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.
skills.name: Earthshaker
skills.scaling_note: AoE damage scales with Strength.

skills.effect: Archery skill that enlivens the arrow with spiritual essence. The resulting shot will fly faster than regular shots and change its trajectory to follow the target.
skills.name: Enchanted Shot

skills.effect: Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
skills.name: Endure
skills.scaling_note: x0.7 damage and Status Buildup received.

skills.effect: Skill of the knights who serve at Volcano Manor. Slam armament into the ground, spawning roiling lava which spouts up upon release.
skills.name: Eruption
skills.scaling_note: Fire damage scales with Intelligence. Lingering lava can stagger smaller enemies.

skills.effect: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Produce a powerful burst of flames in a wide frontward arc.
skills.name: Flame of the Redmanes
skills.scaling_note: Fire damage scales with Strength.

skills.effect: Skill of Queelign of the Fire Knights. Enwreathe armament in flame and assume a low stance before skewering the enemy in a single motion. Strong attack unleashes a follow-up flame attack.
skills.name: Flame Skewer
skills.scaling_note: Fire damage scales with Faith and Arcane.

skills.armaments: Thrusting Armaments - No Claws, Backhand Blades
skills.effect: Skill of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. Ready weapon for a thrusting attack and unleash a spear of flame straight ahead. Charge the attack to increase damage dealt and distance travelled.
skills.name: Flame Spear
skills.scaling_note: Fire damage scales with Faith and Arcane.

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments - No Whips, Colossal Armaments
skills.effect: Skill that emits flame in a wide frontward arc. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lunging, sweeping strike. This will also coat the armament in fire.
skills.name: Flaming Strike
skills.scaling_note: Fire damage scales with Strength.

skills.armaments: Swords, Spears, Staves - No Twinblades, Backhand Blades, Small Armaments
skills.effect: Thrust out armament to summon ghostflame. Follow up with a normal attack to set the ground ablaze with ghostflame, or a strong attack to trigger a massive explosion.
skills.name: Ghostflame Call
skills.scaling_note: Ghostflame damage scales with Intelligence and Faith.

skills.armaments: Spears, Twinblades, Large and Colossal Thrusting Armaments
skills.effect: Skill developed for confronting gigantic foes. Step forward from a low stance, carrying the momentum into a sudden upward thrust.
skills.name: Giant Hunt

skills.armaments: Swords, Polearms (Thrusting), Staves - No Colossal Armaments
skills.effect: Skill used by the enchanted knights who served the Carian royal family. Form an arch of magic glintblades overhead, which will attack foes automatically. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust.
skills.name: Glintblade Phalanx
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Intelligence.

skills.armaments: Swords, Polearms (Thrusting), Staves - No Colossal Armaments
skills.effect: Skill that employs glintstone sorcery of the same name. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust, performed while the armament is still imbued with glintstone.
skills.name: Glintstone Pebble
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Intelligence.

skills.armaments: Greataxes, Great Hammers, Great Spears, Colossal Weapons
skills.effect: Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash a blast of sacred energy that coalesces into golden darts. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.
skills.name: Golden Land
skills.scaling_note: Holy damage scales with Strength.

skills.effect: Perform an Erdtree incantation and swing the shield to deflect enemy attacks and break their stance. Effective even at a slight distance.
skills.name: Golden Parry
skills.scaling_note: Has 5 active parry frames.

skills.effect: Skill of the avatars who protect Minor Erdtrees. Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions. Heavier equip load frames increase skill power.
skills.name: Golden Slam
skills.scaling_note: Holy shockwave damage scales with Strength. Skill damage scales with Equip Load frame, ranging from x0.9 at Nimble Frame to x1.15 at Massive Frame.

skills.effect: Skill passed down from antiquity among the knights of the capital. Raise armament aloft and pledge to honor the Erdtree in battle, granting self and nearby allies increased attack power and defense.
skills.name: Golden Vow
skills.scaling_note: Grants self and allies x0.9 damage taken and x1.1 damage dealt for 30 seconds.

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments, Staves - No Whips, Small Armaments
skills.effect: Skill originating from the Alabaster Lords, who had skin of stone. Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in.
skills.name: Gravitas
skills.scaling_note: Gravity damage scales with Intelligence. Deals True damage.

skills.effect: Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends a powerful shockwave in all directions. Heavier equip load frames increase skill power.
skills.name: Ground Slam
skills.scaling_note: Shockwave damage scales with Strength. Skill damage scales with Equip Load frame, x0.9 at Nimble Frame to x1.15 at Massive Frame.

skills.effect: Slam both hands onto the ground to violently shake the earth and unleash a shockwave. Follow up with an additional input to slam the ground again.
skills.name: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker
skills.scaling_note: AoE damage scales with Strength. Considered a Roar attack.

skills.effect: Stomp hard to spread a trail of freezing mist on the ground. The mist applies the Frostbite status effect.
skills.name: Hoarfrost Stomp
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Dexterity and Intelligence.

skills.effect: Raise shield to create an Erdtree-consecrated area that continuously restores HP and boosts defense for self and allies inside it. Also increases poise attack power.
skills.name: Holy Ground
skills.scaling_note: Up to two consecrated areas may be placed at once. Areas last 50 seconds.

skills.effect: Skill of the warriors who served Lunar Princess Ranni. Spin armament to release cold magic, then channel it into a piercing spear of ice.
skills.name: Ice Spear
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Dexterity and Intelligence.

skills.effect: Skill of Igon, drake warrior. Ready the bow before unleashing a twisted shot with a great bellow that considerably enhances its power.
skills.name: Igon's Drake Hunt

skills.effect: Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
skills.name: Impaling Thrust

skills.effect: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance.
skills.name: Kick
skills.scaling_note: Damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.effect: Skill that demonstrates mastery of the art of controlling vital energies. A slow, controlled punch with an energy-infused fist that renders foes unconscious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build.
skills.name: Lifesteal Fist
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Arcane.

skills.effect: Skill inspired by tumbling rams. Let out a bleat, then tumble forwards, clad in lightning. Tumbles can be repeated in rapid succession.
skills.name: Lightning Ram
skills.scaling_note: Lightning damage scales with Dexterity.

skills.effect: Call down a bolt of lightning into armament, then swing it down to create an explosive shock. The armament retains the lightning enchantment for a while.
skills.name: Lightning Slash
skills.scaling_note: Lightning damage scales with Dexterity.

skills.armaments: Swords, Axes, Hammers - No Thrusting Swords, Small Armaments
skills.effect: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament.
skills.name: Lion's Claw

skills.acquisition: Found in a new Kaiden encampment in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
skills.effect: A skill imparted upon Crucible Knights by their lord. Stomp hard on the ground to bring forth earthen spikes.
skills.name: Lord's Stomp
skills.scaling_note: Spike damage scales with Strength.

skills.effect: Skill of Loretta, the Royal Knight. Leap forward, imbuing the blade with glintstone, then descend, accelerating into a sweeping slash.
skills.name: Loretta's Slash
skills.scaling_note: Magic damage scales with Intelligence.

skills.effect: Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.
skills.name: Mighty Shot

skills.acquisition: Dropped by the Fallen Cavalry boss, on the bridge between Limgrave and Liurnia.
skills.effect: This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.
skills.name: No Skill

skills.effect: A skill that starts with the blade held high in a ready stance. Execute a normal attack from this stance to step forward and slash downwards, or a strong attack to deliver a series of downward slashes.
skills.name: Overhead Stance

skills.effect: Skill of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Imbues hand with energy before using a palm strike to unleash an explosive blast. The already formidable power and impact can be bolstered by charging the attack.
skills.name: Palm Blast

skills.armaments: Daggers, Curved Swords, Thrusting Swords, Fists, Claws, Shields (Small & Medium)
skills.effect: Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance. This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
skills.name: Parry

skills.effect: Skill inspired by the fond remembrances of the Night's Cavalry. Creates an apparition of the knights' former instructor who guides a joint lunging upward swing. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
skills.name: Phantom Slash
skills.scaling_note: Phantom damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.effect: Skill used by Yura, the Bloody Finger Hunter. Starting with the blade held horizontally, make a powerful thrust that cannot be blocked.
skills.name: Piercing Fang

skills.effect: Throw armament with a powerful spin, causing it to bore through foes. When using this skill, the armament can be thrown further than normal and also pierce through enemies.
skills.name: Piercing Throw

skills.effect: Slash with a poison-infused blade. If the follow-up strike lands on a poisoned foe, it will deal significant damage.
skills.name: Poison Moth Flight
skills.scaling_note: Follow-up strike removes only a single stack of Poison buildup. Follow-up burst damage scales with enemy strength (stronger against weaker enemies, weaker against major bosses).

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments - No Whips, Fists, Claws
skills.effect: Bathe armament in poison, and then slash, spreading toxic mist forwards. The armament retains its poison for a while.
skills.name: Poisonous Mist
skills.scaling_note: Mist damage scales with Arcane. Armament buff lasts 15 seconds.

skills.effect: Raise armament aloft in prayer, then slam it into the ground. This inspired blow restores HP to the self and nearby allies if it successfully hits.
skills.name: Prayerful Strike

skills.effect: Slam armament into the ground to create a surge of flames, then charge in. Hold to continue the charge.
skills.name: Prelate's Charge
skills.scaling_note: Fire damage scales with Faith.

skills.effect: Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot. Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
skills.name: Quickstep

skills.effect: Step with the swiftness of a beast, leap high, and slash foe from above. Initial step can be taken forward, backward, left, or right. Strong attack allows for a follow-up attack.
skills.name: Raging Beast

skills.effect: Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow, then fire a burst of arrows into the sky to shower the enemy with projectiles.
skills.name: Rain of Arrows

skills.effect: Hoist the war banner aloft and give a rallying command. Raises attack power and defense for self and nearby allies. Storm attacks gain an even greater increase in attack power.
skills.name: Rallying Standard
skills.scaling_note: After skill use, grants +2 Endurance when empowering an ally, increasing by +1 for each additional ally (stacks up to +10 Endurance). Additional Attack Power and Defense for self and affected allies, and additional Attack Power to storm attacks. Buff also affects sorcery and incantation damage, has a 30% increased duration when cast on allies, and stacks with other buffs.

skills.effect: Imbue arrows with vengeful spirits, before firing off a barrage. Imbued arrows chase down foes as they cut through the air.
skills.name: Rancor Shot

skills.effect: Spin around, slashing foes while summoning vengeful spirits which chase down foes. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
skills.name: Rancor Slash

skills.effect: Duck into a low stance, momentarily vanishing. If an enemy attack connects, avian wings will allow for a quick escape into the air. Half of the consumed FP will be refunded on a successful dodge.
skills.name: Raptor of the Mists

skills.effect: Slaughters prey with sharp claws in a great swipe of the arm. The attack creates a vacuum which deals continuous damage. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
skills.name: Red Bear Hunt

skills.effect: Slash with the wicked dagger, transforming its never-drying bloodstains into airborne blades that cause blood loss. Can be fired in rapid succession.
skills.name: Reduvia Blood Blade
skills.scaling_note: Blood Loss buildup increased, and inflicts a small amount of Blood Loss on the user.

skills.effect: Slam the hammer into the ground, rending the land asunder with the armament's five bestial claws.
skills.name: Regal Beastclaw

skills.effect: Let loose a mighty war cry, raising attack power, while sending out a shockwave that cannot be guarded against by stomping the ground. While active, strong attack becomes a lunging slash.
skills.name: Regal Roar
skills.scaling_note: Animation speed increased. Target priority during animation increased. Range of roar and stomp area of effect increased. Buffs granted by Regal Roar last for 25 seconds.

skills.effect: This skill readies the weapon's rapid-fire mechanism. Once in ready stance, crank the handle to fire bolts in rapid succession.
skills.name: Repeating Fire

skills.effect: Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.
skills.name: Repeating Thrust

skills.effect: Dash up to an enemy and slash them open with the blades held in each hand. By holding down the button, the initial dash will be extended. Follow up with strong attack to hack the enemy to pieces.
skills.name: Revenger's Blade
skills.scaling_note: Followup attack tracking greatly improved.

skills.effect: Scatter perfumed powder before you, triggering rolling explosions of deadly sparks. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used.
skills.name: Rolling Sparks

skills.effect: Imbues bud-blade with scarlet rot butterflies before unleashing two large sweeping slashes. This was once considered a sacred act of purification.
skills.name: Romina's Purification

skills.effect: Raise the axe aloft to summon those lost in death. Three skeletons will appear at a distance and attack in tandem before vanishing.
skills.name: Rosus' Summons
skills.scaling_note: Hitbox size of skeletons increased. Skeletons now deal Slash damage.

skills.effect: Skill of the knights who once served the Elden Lord. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, greatly powering up your next attack.
skills.name: Royal Knight's Resolve

skills.effect: Swing the sword to bathe its blade in ghostflame. The ghostflame increases magic damage, and also has a bitterly cold bite.
skills.name: Ruinous Ghostflame
skills.scaling_note: After skill use, Helphen Steeple receives x1.5/x0.67 Physical Attack Power and +50 Frostbite for 25 seconds.

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments - No Whips, Fists, Claws
skills.effect: Grants armament's attacks holy essence and fires off a golden blade projectile. The armament retains its holy essence for a while.
skills.name: Sacred Blade
skills.scaling_note: Projectile holy damage scales with Faith.

skills.effect: Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Perform a salute and grant the armament holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death.
skills.name: Sacred Order

skills.effect: Release the power of a hidden incantation to erect a palisade of golden spears forwards.
skills.name: Sacred Phalanx
skills.scaling_note: Golden spears last longer, travel further, and penetrate guards.

skills.effect: Skill used by the commanders of the Cleanrot Knights. Gather a sacred ring of light in the armament, then fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.
skills.name: Sacred Ring of Light

skills.effect: Pounce like a beast to viciously slash into foe with left and right claws.
skills.name: Savage Claws

skills.armaments: Swords, Axes, Hammers - No Thrusting Swords, Small Armaments
skills.effect: Skill of the particularly brave, even among the Redmanes. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament. An additional strike may be performed with an additional input.
skills.name: Savage Lion's Claw

skills.effect: Employ smithing arts to conjure multiple copies of the armament in both hands and throw them all at once. Follow up with an additional input to throw again.
skills.name: Scattershot Throw

skills.effect: Swing a molten whip overhead to temporarily cover the surrounding area in a sea of magma. Hold to continue swinging the lava whip.
skills.name: Sea of Magma

skills.armaments: Swords, Polearms (Thrusting) - No Small or Colossal Armaments
skills.effect: A forbidden technique used by swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Plunge the blade into your stomach to stain it with blood. Increases attack power and improves ability to inflict blood loss.
skills.name: Seppuku

skills.effect: Slam down the blossom of a large shadow sunflower, sending out a shockwave that flattens foes. Additional inputs allow for repeated followup attacks, while heavy attacks will end the combo with a final attack.
skills.name: Shadow Sunflower Headbutt

skills.effect: Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Grant self and nearby allies an aura of holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death.
skills.name: Shared Order

skills.effect: Brace behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.
skills.name: Shield Bash

skills.effect: Two-hand the shield and charge forwards while maintaining guard. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards and can even be staggered. Hold to extend the duration of the charge forwards.
skills.name: Shield Crash
skills.scaling_note: Benefits from bonuses to running attacks.

skills.effect: Lets out a horrific cursed scream that reduces all damage negation and status resistances for nearby foes. While active, strong attacks will change to a combo attack.
skills.name: Shriek of Milos

skills.effect: Thrust the weapon in a spiraling motion, surrounding it in a vortex of wind. Charged attacks have the power to blow away enemies and can fire the tornado forwards.
skills.name: Siluria's Woe
skills.scaling_note: Projectile and melee hits can both hit the same enemy.

skills.effect: Pierces the enemy deeply with a poison-coated needle that deals heavy sleep buildup. If the follow-up strike lands upon a foe who is already in a state of slumber, it will deal significant damage.
skills.name: Sleep Evermore

skills.effect: Slam the red-hot anvil into the ground, sending up countless spears as it is pulled out. The spears disappear instantly.
skills.name: Smithing Art Spears

skills.effect: Sharply slash downward using the greatsword, shooting forward an arc of light. Strong attack allows for an advancing follow-up.
skills.name: Solitary Moon Slash

skills.effect: Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.
skills.name: Sorcery of the Crozier

skills.effect: Raise the greathorn's wings to summon a soul-sapping miasma. Enemies in the affected area will temporarily suffer from reduced damage negation and constant sleep buildup.
skills.name: Soul Stifler

skills.effect: Thrust the spear high, bearing prayers into the sky to summon a downpour of spectral spears.
skills.name: Spearcall Ritual
skills.scaling_note: Projectile spread and hitbox size increased.

skills.effect: Skill of the headless Mausoleum Knights. Hurl a phantasmic spear at foes.
skills.name: Spectral Lance
skills.scaling_note: Projectile damage scales with Arcane. Lance pierces targets and has no projectile damage falloff.

skills.acquisition: Dropped by the Night's Cavalry in Dragonbarrow.
skills.effect: Spins the striking part of a flail at high speed to attack. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to link the momentum of this skill into a successive attack.
skills.name: Spinning Chain

skills.effect: A gravity skill honed by the disciples of an Alabaster Lord. Uses gravitational power to hang in the air before rotating the body and charging forward. An additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
skills.name: Spinning Gravity Thrust

skills.effect: Hold the putrid blade at both ends and arch body backwards to deliver a powerful overhead chop. Repeated inputs deliver follow-up attacks for as long as stamina allows. Strong attack performs a leap followed by a spinning attack.
skills.name: Spinning Guillotine

skills.armaments: Swords, Axes, Polearms - No Colossal Armaments
skills.effect: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additionally input allows for a follow-up attack.
skills.name: Spinning Slash

skills.armaments: Carian Regal Scepter, Snow Witch Scepter
skills.effect: Channel magic into the glintstone to suspend the scepter in mid air and cause it to spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive magic attacks.
skills.name: Spinning Staff
skills.scaling_note: Has blocking frames and will deflect projectiles.

skills.effect: Polearm skill that performs continuous spinning attacks. Hold to continue the attack. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack. Nullifies projectiles such as arrows while spinning.
skills.name: Spinning Strikes

skills.armaments: Swords (Small and Medium), Axes, Hammers, Polearms, Staves - No Great Spears
skills.effect: Defensive skill employed by Carian princesses. Lifts armament into mid-air, then makes it spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive attacks.
skills.name: Spinning Weapon
skills.scaling_note: Has blocking frames and deflects projectiles.

skills.effect: Strike the wheel against the ground to set it spinning at top speed. Hold to keep the wheel spinning. Can be used while walking to push the armament into enemies.
skills.name: Spinning Wheel

skills.effect: Imbue the Naturalborn's stars with magic to perform a sweeping strike. This attack leaves a dark cloud of stars in its wake that lingers briefly before exploding.
skills.name: Spiral Nebula

skills.effect: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skills.name: Square Off

skills.armaments: Swords, Axes, Hammers - No Small or Medium Swords
skills.effect: Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a normal attack for a sweeping strike, or with a strong attack for an upward strike.
skills.name: Stamp

skills.effect: Bring the two swords together and roar into the skies, pulling in enemies with a gravitational wave. Follow up with an additional input to slam down with gravity-infused swords. The follow up attack fortifies the swords with stone, increasing attack power and making it easier to break enemy stance.
skills.name: Starcaller Cry
skills.scaling_note: After skill follow-up attack, Starscourge Greatswords receive x1.03 Physical Attack Power, x1.09 Poise Damage, x1.15 Stamina Damage, +60 Lightning Damage for 20 seconds. Skill animation speed increased.

skills.effect: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Leap forward through surrounding storm winds and thrust armament downward. The attack will produce more storm winds at the point of impact.
skills.name: Storm Assault
skills.scaling_note: Storm projectile damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.effect: Lost skill of Stormveil. Surround armament with shearing storm winds that can be fired forward. Can be fired in rapid succession.
skills.name: Storm Blade
skills.scaling_note: Storm projectile damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.effect: Thrust the prosthetic leg blade into the ground, creating a storm. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lightning-infused jumping attack.
skills.name: Storm Kick

skills.effect: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Stomp hard on the ground to kick up a momentary storm.
skills.name: Storm Stomp
skills.scaling_note: Storm projectile damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.effect: Swing the shield to create a wall of storm winds in front of you, deflecting arrows and other such physical projectiles. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry.
skills.name: Storm Wall

skills.armaments: Swords (Slashing), Axes, Hammers, Polearms - No Small or Colossal Armaments
skills.effect: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Spin armament to create surrounding storm winds. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
skills.name: Stormcaller
skills.scaling_note: Storm projectile damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.effect: Set the flames of Birac's faith ablaze in the cranial vessel, then raise it aloft to rain down fireballs in all directions. Repeated inputs will continue to raise the armament aloft, continuing the attack. Fire from this skill burns targets.
skills.name: Surge of Faith
skills.scaling_note: Animation speed greatly increased. Fire projectiles have larger hitboxes and slightly track targets.

skills.effect: A skill passed down amongst hornsent swordsmen. Take a swift forward step to slice through foes. This sharp strike also fires off a shearing vacuum. Can be charged to increase the skill's power and the distance of the forward step.
skills.name: Swift Slash

skills.armaments: Swords, Axes, Polearms (Slashing) - No Colossal Armaments, Great Spears
skills.effect: Quickly close in to perform a series of spinning upward slashes. Follow up with an additional input to finish with a downward slash.
skills.name: Sword Dance

skills.effect: Raise the sacred sword aloft to set it ablaze with blasphemous flames, then bring it down to fire off a forward blast. The flames steal HP from those they touch.
skills.name: Taker's Flames

skills.effect: Set the blade ablaze with god-slaying black flame before delivering a sweeping slash. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack. The black flames will persist in the spiral blade for a while.
skills.name: The Queen's Black Flame
skills.scaling_note: After skill use, Godslayer's Greatsword receives x1.03 Fire Attack Power / +30 Fire Damage for 10 seconds. Attacks inflict Black Flame.

skills.effect: (Replaces: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice) Conjures stingers of scarlet rot from below to stab the enemy. Landing the attack on a foe already inflicted with rot deals massive damage in one fell swoop.
skills.name: The Rotten Flower Blooms Twice
skills.scaling_note: Stinger damage scales with Dexterity and Faith. Removes only one stack of Scarlet Rot on enemies. Damage scales based on enemy strength, being more effective on weaker enemies and less effective against major bosses.

skills.effect: Erect a magical forcefield while swinging the shield to deflect sorceries and incantations. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry.
skills.name: Thops's Barrier
skills.scaling_note: Now has an FP cost, but has 5 parry frames and the projectile deflection radius has been significantly increased, making this ash more reliable.

skills.effect: Powerful archery skill using a greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready the greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies.
skills.name: Through and Through

skills.effect: Skill used by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Raise armament aloft to call down a bolt of lightning. Can be fired in rapid succession.
skills.name: Thunderbolt
skills.scaling_note: Lightning damage scales with Faith. Penetrates enemy guards.

skills.effect: Temporarily transform into a red thundercloud and fly through the air, then plunge down with a lightning-infused blade. Hold to increase the reach of the thundercloud form.
skills.name: Thundercloud Form
skills.scaling_note: I-Frames added to portions of the skill where player model is invisible.

skills.effect: Imbue the armament's wing-blade with lightning and swing it around to create a tempestuous lightning storm. Follow up with an additional input to perform up to two spinning attacks. The lightning will stay on the blade for a while.
skills.name: Thunderstorm

skills.effect: Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with either a normal or a strong attack to draw the blade at great speed for an instant parry or slash attack. Both attacks fire off a wave of light.
skills.name: Transient Moonlight
skills.scaling_note: Skill R1 is a parry and does not deal direct melee damage. Distance of R1 projectiles increased. Projectile damage of R1 parry and R2 attack is identical.

skills.effect: Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down, unleashing the Flame of the Fell God.
skills.name: Troll's Raging Roar

skills.effect: Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down.
skills.name: Troll's Roar
skills.scaling_note: Roar damage scales with Strength.

skills.effect: Imbue the cipher blade with light, then lunge forward with a sudden piercing attack. This attack can not be blocked.
skills.name: Unblockable Piercing Blade

skills.effect: Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack. This attack cannot be blocked.
skills.name: Unblockable Rending Blade
skills.scaling_note: Skill speed increased.

skills.effect: A furious dance formed by a succession of slashing attacks. Hold the button down to sustain the dance for as long as stamina allows.
skills.name: Unending Dance

skills.effect: Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift parry or slash attack.
skills.name: Unsheathe

skills.effect: Lost skill of ancient heroes. Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.
skills.name: Vacuum Slice
skills.scaling_note: Storm projectile damage scales with Strength and Dexterity.

skills.effect: Skill of the ancient warriors of the Erdtree. Hold shield aloft to imbue yourself with golden power, granting momentary invincibility.
skills.name: Vow of the Indomitable

skills.effect: Scatter perfumed powder in vicinity, producing intense sparks after a brief delay. Can be charged to increase power and range. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used.
skills.name: Wall of Sparks

skills.armaments: Melee Armaments - No Daggers, Thrusting Swords, Whips
skills.effect: Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
skills.name: War Cry
skills.scaling_note: Roar damage scales with Strength. Target priority increased during animation. Does not overwrite other weapon buffs.

skills.effect: Perform a series of one-footed leaps in the manner of a waterfowl to unleash a swift yet graceful slashing combo. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
skills.name: Waterfowl Dance

skills.effect: Raise the sword up high, then strike it against the ground to fire off a wave of gravitational force.
skills.name: Wave of Destruction

skills.effect: Imbue the sword with bygone golden glory, then fire it at foes. A wide, golden wave fans out forwards, sweeping through all enemies caught in its path.
skills.name: Wave of Gold
skills.scaling_note: Skill speed increased.

skills.armaments: Greataxes, Great Hammers, Great Spears, Colossal Weapons
skills.effect: Plunge armament into the ground to release three waves of darkness. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.
skills.name: Waves of Darkness
skills.scaling_note: Gravity wave damage scales with Intelligence. Deals True damage.

skills.effect: Performs scythe-like horizontal swings with the sword, cutting men down as if they were weeds. Additional inputs allow for the continuation of the attack for as long as stamina remains.
skills.name: Weed Cutter

skills.effect: Summons white light from the crevice in the weapon's ancient meteoric ore, using its power for a charging attack which pierces foes. Additional input causes the light to explode.
skills.name: White Light Charge

skills.effect: Hold armament in a brief, silent prayer to create a white shadow. The apparition lures in foes of human build who are not in combat, drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state.
skills.name: White Shadow's Lure

skills.effect: Swing armament with wild abandon. Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
skills.name: Wild Strikes

skills.effect: Calmly assume a right-sided stance. Normal attack triggers a rapid three-slash combination. Strong attack triggers a leaping thrust.
skills.name: Wing Stance

skills.effect: Hold the sword level and infuse it with the dark of Night before unleashing a series of incorporeal attacks. This attack cannot be blocked. Can be charged to increase its power.
skills.name: Witching Hour Slash

skills.effect: Infuse the greatsword with frost, then perform a forward somersault to plunge it into the ground. Then, pull it out to release a cold blast.
skills.name: Wolf's Assault
skills.scaling_note: Frostbite buildup increased.

skills.effect: Plunge the curved sword into the ground, building power before unleashing a freezing storm that batters the surroundings.
skills.name: Zamor Ice Storm
